A.evidence: The tracking code indexes packed intermediate SSM states by per-request chunk counts, while the kernel writes them on one global chunk grid over the batch, so the wrong state is cached; the merged fix corrects the indexing.

B.evidence: _init_track_ssm_indices computes offsets assuming a per-request-local contiguous count, but the kernel it reads from indexes states by a global physical chunk grid, so unaligned earlier requests cause a wrong state to be read.

A.evidence: Following the tokenizer_class declared in tokenizer_config.json, transformers loads SentencePiece-based LlamaTokenizer, which cannot apply the ByteLevel-BPE pipeline in tokenizer.json; the fix routes these models to TokenizersBackend.

B.evidence: DeepSeek-Coder v1 declares model_type llama and matches the registered class exactly, so the MODELS_WITH_INCORRECT_HUB_TOKENIZER_CLASS override never fires and it falls through to the wrong (SentencePiece) tokenizer class.

C.evidence: DeepSeek-Coder v1 declares tokenizer_class LlamaTokenizerFast, so the override never fired and the SentencePiece-based LlamaTokenizer read its ByteLevel-BPE tokenizer.json under the wrong assumption and stripped whitespace, and the merged fix maps these models to TokenizersBackend.

A.evidence: DCP virtual KV locations are used without translation against per-rank buffers because the norope write kernel and the sparse read paths lack DCP rank localization.

B.evidence: The norope KV-write kernel has no DCP_RANK/DCP_WORLD_SIZE translation that the rope variant has, so virtual (global) locations are used raw against per-rank-sized physical buffers.
